source: NHTSA vPIC API (https://vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/api/): GetWMIsForManufacturer and DecodeWMI answers, fetched 2026-11-26 at 1 request per 1.5 s; US government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105)

fields.manufacturer: NHTSA registrant name for the WMI (for some foreign WMIs the US importer, e.g. 9BW = VOLKSWAGEN GROUP OF AMERICA, INC.); null for curated rows
fields.make: brand (vPIC DecodeWMI Make, or the curated brand for WMIs vPIC does not list)
fields.vehicle_types: vPIC vehicle types registered under the WMI
fields.source: 'nhtsa_vpic' or 'curated' (Brazilian WMIs of makers never registered for the US market; a brand hint from public Brazilian VIN usage, not verified against NHTSA)
fields.shared: small-manufacturer WMI (third character 9) shared by several registrants: positions 12-14 identify the maker
fields.country: never stored: the module derives it from the ISO 3780 range of the first two characters (vPIC's Country is the registrant's, e.g. 9BW -> MEXICO)
